Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Helpful to hear more about the Acme search/QA use case and the latency/cost targets you mentioned. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align calendars for the technical kickoff:

- Goal: run a 2-week evaluation focused on relevance and latency under a representative prompt set. Success criteria: 90% relevance score on your internal eval rubric + median p95 token latency < 350ms for the production prompt mix.
- Proposed kickoff: technical deep-dive + trial plan walkthrough (30-45m) — cover test dataset, metrics, infra requirements, and measurement plan.
- Timing: Are you available Tue/Wed next week 10:00-12:00 PT or Thu 2:00-4:00 PT? Connor (cc'd) will join for infra and trial logistics.
- Deliverables before kickoff: draft trial plan, access checklist (sample API keys, sandbox datasets), and prompt set example. I can send a draft trial plan ahead of the meeting.

If that looks good, pick one or two slots and I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda. Also happy to loop in security/ops if you want to cover SOC 2 / data handling in the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—Marissa
